method.enumeration: all reduced a/b with b>0, max(abs(a),b)<=height, and a=2142*b mod 4403
method.exact_postprocessing: H(T) is evaluated exactly for retained candidates and its 7-, 17-, and 37-adic valuations are recorded
method.rank_seed: optional PARI ellrank calls receive exact Jacobian images 2--13; their height determinant is numerical evidence only
method.score_scope: good reduction only at numerical primes 5<=p<=score_bound; primes dividing b and bad-reduction residues are excluded

status: bounded exhaustive residue-class experiment; good-prime scores are heuristics, PARI rank fields are computational bounds only, and the benchmark rank is published metadata
